site.name: Cursed Ink Society
site.description: Premium tattoo collective in Houma, Louisiana - Where artistry meets community

hero.headline: Timeless Art. Meticulous Execution.
hero.subhead: Six master artists, one extraordinary collective. From traditional to contemporary, we bring your vision to life with uncompromising quality and artistic integrity.

artists.name: Seth Wood
artists.positioning: Master of Naturalistic American Traditional & Japanese - Timeless artistry with 25+ years of mastery
artists.bio: Seth Wood is a tattoo artist with over 25 years of experience, specializing in naturalistic interpretations of American Traditional and Japanese tattooing. His work reflects decades of dedication to the craft, bringing authenticity and depth to every piece.

artists.name: Ashley Wood
artists.positioning: Color & Newschool Specialist - Injecting vibrant energy and pop culture magic into every piece
artists.bio: Ashley Wood brings vibrant energy to tattooing through her mastery of color work and newschool styles. Her passion for pop culture and kawaii aesthetics creates pieces that are both bold and playful.

artists.name: Anthony Boudreaux
artists.positioning: Versatile Walk-In Specialist - Your vision, our expertise, immediate availability
artists.bio: Anthony Boudreaux is known for his versatility and approachable style, making him the perfect choice for walk-in consultations. His work spans traditional and modern styles with a focus on custom design work.

artists.name: Luis Reymundo
artists.positioning: Bold Linework & Geometric Master - Precision meets creativity in every design
artists.bio: Luis Reymundo specializes in bold linework and geometric patterns, creating striking pieces that combine precision with artistic vision. His work stands out for its clean execution and creative compositions.

artists.name: Cody Crochet
artists.positioning: Realism & Portrait Specialist - Capturing life's moments with photorealistic precision
artists.bio: Cody Crochet is a 10-year veteran tattoo artist specializing in anime, illustrated, and videogame tattoos. His color work brings characters and designs to life with incredible detail and vibrancy.

artists.name: Trent
artists.positioning: Neo-Traditional & Illustrative - Classic techniques meet modern vision
artists.bio: Trent brings together classic neo-traditional techniques with modern illustrative approaches, creating timeless pieces that stand out for their craftsmanship and artistic vision.

process.title: Consultation & Design
process.description: We start with your vision. Our artists collaborate with you to refine concepts, discuss placement, and create a custom design that exceeds expectations.

process.title: Precision Application
process.description: Using only premium equipment and techniques, your tattoo is applied with meticulous attention to detail, sterilization, and client comfort.

process.title: Healing & Aftercare
process.description: Complete aftercare instructions, premium healing products, and ongoing support ensure your tattoo heals beautifully and maintains its vibrancy.

contactCta.headline: Ready to Begin Your Artistic Journey?
contactCta.subhead: Connect with our master artists and transform your vision into wearable art that tells your story.
